evidence.excerpt:
`--recursive=y` ignores `ignore-paths`
### Bug description

When running recursively, it seems `ignore-paths` in my settings in pyproject.toml is completely ignored

### Configuration

```ini
[tool.pylint.MASTER]
ignore-paths = [
  # Auto generated
  "^src/gen/.*$",
]
```


### Command used

```shell
pylint --recursive=y src/

hindsight_observations.description: The hindsight implementation diagnoses inconsistent path spelling at ignore matching time: normalizing the candidate path before basename and regex checks makes the recursive current-directory case honor the anchored ignore-path pattern.
The added regression test specifically exposes the bug when recursive discovery starts from "." and the ignore-path expression is anchored to a child directory using a forward slash.
The supplied regression suite indicates the focused fix passed the new failing case without breaking the enumerated existing self-tests.

implementation_incidentals.description: The gold implementation chose to call os.path.normpath inside the shared _is_ignored_file helper; normalization elsewhere in recursive discovery or at another matching boundary could also satisfy the required behavior.

The regression test used existing _test_sys_path and _test_cwd helpers, filtered regrtest_data from sys.path, changed into a particular fixture directory, and asserted success through _runtest; these are test-harness details rather than product behavior.
